title: Spicy Guacamole with Chipotle
description: Amped up with jalapeno and chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, this spicy guacamole is great as a dip or on sandwiches, burgers, or soups.
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped, divided
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.25 cup seeded and diced jalapeno peppers

steps.text: Cut open avocados and scoop all the flesh into a large bowl. Mash with a bean masher or spoon until there are no large chunks of avocado left.

Squeeze lime juice over the avocado. Add cilantro and 1 chipotle pepper with some adobo sauce. Season with salt and pepper; mix to combine. Mix in red onion and jalapenos. Add tomato and mix gently to combine. Chill before serving garnished with remaining chipotle pepper and adobo sauce.
